subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Haryana.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Chandigarh. Haryana covers a geographic area of 44,212 sq km across 22 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Yamuna, Ghaggar-Hakra, Markanda, Tangri.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Land of the epic Mahabharata battle of Kurukshetra. Major industrial and automobile powerhouse (Gurugram, Maruti Suzuki), and India's top Olympic sports medal-producing state.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Haryana.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Haryana was formally instituted on 1 November 1966. Official language(s): Hindi.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Dhamal, Khoria, Phag, Saang, Ragini.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Surajkund International Crafts Mela, Gita Mahotsav, Teej.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Haryana.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Bandaru Dattatreya.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Haryana is Nayab Singh Saini.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Punjab and Haryana High Court (Chandigarh).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Blackbuck | State Bird: Black francolin | State Flower: Lotus | State Tree: Peepal.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Haryana.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Limestone, Slate, Quartzite, China clay.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Haryana plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Haryana.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Brahma Sarovar (Kurukshetra), Sheikh Chilli's Tomb (Thanesar), Jal Mahal (Narnaul), Pinjore Gardens.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Sultanpur National Park (Ramsar Site), Kalesar National Park.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Haryana.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Parivar Pehchan Patra, Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivar Utthan Yojana, Chirayu Haryana.
